title: spec/test-vectors/rpl.json: stale duplicate DIO/DAO-ACK corpus asserts rejected SHA-512 native DODAGID
description: Found by correctness codereview of nwm8 (worker4). spec/test-vectors/rpl.json:48-49,59,66,76,136,142 still carries the rejected SHA-512 native profile DODAGID (027dd5cfc679ab637dd5cfc679ab6342 / string 27d:d5cf:...) in 6 occurrences across the same DIO/DAO-ACK vectors just migrated in the canonical corpus test/vectors/rpl_messages.json (nwm8, upstream AddrForKey 202:24ae:...). Its dio_base description claims 'AddrForKey DODAGID' — false. No code consumes this file (only spec/test-vectors/frame.json has live consumers), but spec/appendix-c-safety.md:383 names spec/test-vectors/ as the test-vector location, so a spec reader sees bytes contradicting the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision and the migrated canonical corpus. Per project policy (report conflicting legacy fixtures): migrate to upstream AddrForKey, quarantine-label like gcp3_trust_models.json/x25519.json, or remove in favor of test/vectors/rpl_messages.json. P3 (unconsumed but spec-referenced).
